translations.web: However the high places were not taken away, and the people had still not set their hearts on the God of their fathers.
translations.bsb: The high places, however, were not removed; the people had not yet set their hearts on the God of their fathers.
translations.kjv: Howbeit the high places were not taken away: for as yet the people had not prepared their hearts unto the God of their fathers.
translations.asv: Howbeit the high places were not taken away; neither as yet had the people set their hearts unto the God of their fathers.
